evaluator.description:
Cache size holding the evaluator instance which includes compiled exprs, parsed ASTs, simple metrics, compound metrics,
source type fetch results with hierarchies and other information to be used during evaluation

normalized.description: Cache size holding normalized timeseries data. This will typically be a NormalizedTimeseries object

tsDecl.description: Cache size holding fetched data points to be used for tsDecl calculation

title: Type to indicate the cache size (memory) for the evaluator, normalized data and tsDecl data
